From new names, to old names, to unlikely names, there were quite the selection of new tracks to choose from for Metal Injection's top tracks of the week for the first week of October.

We had one of the metal grandfathers bless us with a new track as Tony Iommi unleashed his second single of the year titled "Stormwatcher," a more melancholic offering, but epic in its entirety. Viking metallers Amon Amarth also released their newest effort today, titled The Allfather Awakens, and the title track has certainly given those wishing for a quest something to sink their teeth into. Everyone's favorite alt-metal oddballs A Perfect Circle released a dynamic offering with their single, "To Whom It May Concern," a melodious and eerie track that feels essential for Spooky Month listening.

We also have alt-rockers Dead Poet Society and their newest record, Monarch, that was also released today, an effort that treads an alt-rock and prog line with a heavy amount of industrial and grunge influences, their lead single, "Hollywood On Fire," a shining example of that nature. We also have prog powerhouse TEMIC, a supergroup consisting of members from Devin Townsend, Mike Portnoy's Shattered Fortress, Haken, and more, and their newest single, "Casting Stone," a diverse release from the conceptual record surrounding grief that is out this time next week (October 9). Then, we have violin-metal unit Imminence–even though they are much more than the band with the violin–and their new album, Axis Mundi, out today with the lead single, "Shed Your Skin."

In terms of newer bands you need to check out, The Arson Choir is delivering a seriously crushing take on heavy music that calls to mind metalcore's chaotic end ala The Dillinger Escape Plan. "A Thousand Terrible" twists, turns, and hits you in the face every step of the way.

With so much to choose from in heavy music, these are Metal Injection's top metal tracks of the week.

  1. Tony Iommi, "Stormwatcher"
  2. To The Grave, "LIMB FROM LAMB"
  3. Amon Amarth, "The Allfather Awakens"
  4. Imminence, "Shed Your Skin"
  5. A Perfect Circle, "To Whom It May Concern"
  6. Rev3rent, "Lacerations and the Feeling of Dying"
  7. Of Virtue, "Too Late"
  8. TEMIC, "Casting Stone"
  9. Dead Poet Society, "Hollywood On Fire"
  10. The Arson Choir, "A Thousand Terrible Things"
